name: Youon Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Youon Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, and manufacture of hydrogen energy products in China and internationally. It offers hydrogen-powered bicycles, including Y900, Y800, S100, and Y200; Q100, a hydrogen generating machine; hydrogen storage systems comprising high-power hydrogen fuel cells, solid-state hydrogen tanks, and full-wrapped carbon fiber high-pressure cylinders; and hydrogen fuel cells. The company also provides docking bicycle sharing systems for electrically assisted and hydrogen bicycles, as well as manual bicycles.
